scope: Capture recipes only; the manifest never opens devices or adds captures.
capture_sources: One user-selected window or game capture

slots.instructions: Add a user-selected source at order 1. Frame remains order >=2. Match 16:9; nonmatching capture aspect uses contain, never implied crop. These slots add layers against the whole-project limit.

notes: Do not install two complete collections in one project. Their combined graph exceeds limits.
Frame interiors are transparent PNG. Empty previews show background, not a simulated camera.
Count all selected capture slots before adding them; reserve is not a promise for a pre-existing project.
The same camera/window may be reused across scenes with distinct layer transforms.
Optional native-only adaptation: omit image motif/frame layers, draw a native rectangle border around the capture; this is a manual recipe, not a second manifest/importer.
